name: bash
description: Shell command discipline: quoting, pipes, text tools, find, process control, portability, non-interactive flags, and script-writing rules.

quoting.summary: Quoting and expansion: word splitting, globbing, $var vs "$var" vs ${var:?}, arrays, $(...) and heredocs

pipes.summary: Pipes, redirection, exit codes, pipefail, &&/||/;, subshells, process substitution, tee, here-strings

text.summary: Text processing: grep/rg, sed, awk, cut, sort, uniq, tr, jq, column; portable idioms and traps

find.summary: find and xargs: -print0/-0, -exec vs xargs, pruning, size/time filters, parallel -P, fd/rg alternatives

process.summary: Process control: timeout, background jobs, wait, traps, signals, nohup, exit codes by convention, PID files

portability.summary: bash vs sh vs zsh, GNU vs BSD vs busybox (sed -i, date, readlink, xargs), WSL and the PowerShell/cmd boundary

noninteractive.summary: Running without a human: every tool that prompts or pages and its non-interactive flag; detecting a hang; timeouts

scripts.summary: Writing scripts: shebang, set -euo pipefail, functions, argument parsing, usage, temp files, logging, idempotence
